topic: One-tile mastery chapter and delayed field expansion
currentUserGoal: Keep the inherited field at one tile for a meaningful opening chapter, let that tile earn several real upgrades, and only then expand to more tiles while preserving the redesign's improved sensory direction.
workCompleted: Replaced the first-touch 2x2 jump with four cumulative one-tile care upgrades: Soft Loam at 6 care RT, Dew Veins at 14, Root Heart at 24, and Ancient Crown at 36.
Made the care upgrades mechanically meaningful: cumulative manual healing rises to +25% and root recovery becomes up to 30% faster.
Carried cumulative one-tile care RT across failed attempts within the current session so partial mastery is not erased by dormancy.
Delayed expansion to 2x2 until Ancient Crown at 36 cumulative care RT, delayed 3x3 until 50, and preserved Hold the Line as the 5x5 gate.
Added an isolated-tile Scourge drain modifier: one-tile drain is 58% of normal while elapsed time and pressure still advance normally; full drain resumes at 2x2.
Added visible tile evolution from dormant moss through existing grass textures, a three-line mastery label, rank-colored aura/tile framing, upgrade rings, SFX, and authored Sensi barks.
Kept Dew Pulse and Tiny Sprinkler hidden and unusable until after the first expansion so the opening teaches direct care before run tools.
Shortened the run HUD objective line to a one-line goal format so new progression copy no longer overlaps the HP bar.
Updated the durable redesign and implementation-plan documents to make one-tile mastery the canonical opening progression.
Expanded unit coverage for mastery order, effects, cross-run cumulative progress, expansion gates, and temporary drain multipliers.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 34 Vitest tests, TypeScript, and Vite production build.
Browser playthrough confirmed ranks 0-3 remain at activeRootCount 1 and activeGridSize 1.
Continuous playtest-route smoke reached Ancient Crown on the thirteenth paced touch at 36 care RT, expanded to 2x2, and remained active at 46 HP.
Browser screenshots confirmed the shortened objective line no longer overlaps the HP bar and the taller one-tile panel contains all three mastery-label lines.
Browser console check reported no errors.
currentGitStatus: Expected after this handoff commit: clean worktree on codex/gameplay-update, five commits ahead of origin/codex/gameplay-update.
knownIssues: One-tile objective/mastery progress persists across attempts only while the current page session remains alive; the narrow redesign save still stores only permanent GT and permanent memory upgrades.
The four opening upgrades are automatic milestone rewards, not player-selected branches or purchases. A later progression slice can add choice after the core cadence is proven.
Full Scourge drain resumes at 2x2. Browser smoke proved the player survives the transition, but the user should judge whether the post-Crown pressure ramp feels fair in a complete hands-on run.
This slice browser-tested the first 2x2 expansion. The 50-care-RT 3x3 gate and wound lesson remain unit-covered but should receive another full browser playthrough when their pacing is tuned.
nextRecommendedSteps: Have the user play the opening with audio enabled and judge whether four upgrades over roughly thirteen paced touches feels satisfyingly long rather than repetitive.
Tune milestone thresholds, one-tile drain protection, and upgrade gains from that hands-on feedback before adding more ranks.
Then deepen the 2x2-to-3x3 chapter with a small set of meaningful field choices so expansion continues to feel earned instead of becoming another automatic counter gate.
Continue the visual/audio polish pass with field lighting, stronger rank-up sound variation, and richer expansion staging while preserving existing pixel assets.
doNotRevert: Do not restore expansion on the first successful touch; one-tile mastery is now the canonical opening pacing rule.
Keep the opening upgrades mechanically real and cumulative rather than reducing them to cosmetic objective labels.
Keep run tools gated until after Ancient Crown so the one-tile chapter remains focused.
Keep one-tile drain protection scoped to the isolated tile; do not globally undo the post-expansion balance the user preferred.
Do not reintroduce long objective copy into the single-line HUD lane above the HP bar.
